2577-6798-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6798-7084-8345.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1164-2173-4666-4740.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-2173-4666-4740.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and sacrificing it.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Mirror of Fate from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mirror of Fate ability, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-2173-4666-4740.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

728-967-2557-3809-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-4885-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4885-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-4885-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-3125-5256-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5256-7396.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7519.description:
Cast Demonic Tutor using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Woe.
When Emeritus of Woe enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

801-5220-5256-7855.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3373-7450.description:
Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, discard half their hand, and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Ensure that you don't sacrifice Astarion.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
3373-7450.notes: If the opponent targeted by Astarion had an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. Otherwise, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

423-1437-3257-3819.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3257-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3257-3819.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

7-3698-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least thrree creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-3698-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1978-5527-7280.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-5527-7280.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Donatello.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4484-4668-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5643-5686.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4668-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1606-5056-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Ley Weaver using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

101-232-1235-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

539-5231-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1379-4779-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

549-856-5256-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5231-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5231-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5231-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

2341-3649-5904.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-3649-5904.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Adric and The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {3}{U} and tapping them, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

967-5173-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

411-2486-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-2486-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
2292-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2292-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-6270-6271.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6270-6271.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as a 6/6 Insect Ooze due to March of the World Ooze, Vaultborn Tyrant's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1486-1753-2085-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2085-4875.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2085-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

710-1703-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5330-5365-5395.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
5330-5365-5395.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' third ability and Piper Wright's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Piper Wright trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability from step 1, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2459-3156-3661-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Rograkh.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Nissa, Vastwood Seer // Nissa, Sage Animist

175-3461-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.Sage Animist.
175-3461-3525.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

1110-1823-2864-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness six or less.
You do not control an Army.
1110-1823-2864-4050.description:
Activate That Which Was Taken by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a divinity counter on a creature an opponent controls with toughness six or less.
Activate Fall of Cair Andros by paying {7}{R}, dealing seven damage to the creature that has a divinity counter on it.
Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army and putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Army enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Army, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, with a Terror of the Peaks trigger on the stack, you may use Fall of Cair Andros' ability to deal infinite damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it, thus causing the Army to have infinite +1/+1 counters on it, which causes Terror of the Peaks to deal infinite damage to any target.

3430-4474-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Soliton.
3430-4474-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2583-3484-4483.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three energy counters.
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
2583-3484-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Decoction Module.
Echo Storm triggers, creating at least one copy of Echo Storm, with one copy targeting Decoction Module.
Resolve all Echo Storms, causing you to create two token copies of Decoction Module.
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, each Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 4.

1545-1636-2308.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
You have a way to gain life.
1545-1636-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to the Fungus Beast's toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3151-3464.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-3464.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-2364-2734.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

1367-3288.notablePrerequisites:
You control and own a nontoken creature.
No creatures in library.
1367-3288.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate, shuffling it into your library.
Activate Proteus Staff targeting the nontoken creature you control, putting it on the bottom of your library and revealing cards until you reveal the nontoken creature and putting putting Nexus of Fate on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
Draw a card.
Repeat.

1424-3957-4476.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
1424-3957-4476.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Answered Prayers, turning Answered Prayers into an Angel and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
